message: Heavy rainfall expected across the district over the next 24 hours. Low-lying areas may experience waterlogging.
River water levels approaching danger mark. Residents near the riverbank advised to move to higher ground.
A cyclonic system is intensifying over the coast and may make landfall within 48 hours.
Wind speeds of 40-50 km/h expected this evening. Secure loose outdoor structures.
Extremely heavy rainfall recorded in the last 3 hours. Flash flooding possible in low-lying settlements.
